thread:
zara: Quick sync: PM asking if we can ship an alpha for egress IP preservation next sprint. Need a realistic minimal scope.

felix: I'd keep alpha very small: two install profiles only — `relay` (our managed egress) and `pinned-egress` (customer requests static egress). No BGP for alpha.

renee: Field wants BGP support eventually but agrees alpha can be static-NAT-based pinning. We should call out limitations up front.

field-sam: Pilot customers prefer preserved IPs across upgrades. They accept small maintenance windows. Can we guarantee stable IP for restart+upgrade?

felix: For alpha we can persist egress mapping in operator state and reapply after upgrade. Not perfect for OSS NAT46/generic NAT setups.

zara: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Operator can rebind same egress IP after control-plane restart for pinned mode; 2) Docs + CLI examples; 3) Two pilot customers validated for 48h.

renee: Add telemetry: egress-bind success rate, timestamp of last rebind, and a reconciliation failure counter visible in Console.

felix: Risk: some clouds reclaim IPs on instance replacement. That needs explicit warning and a fallback path. We'll add a healthcheck that detects reclaim and alerts.

field-sam: For upgrade choreography, let's require a dry-run step: `rictl upgrade --dry-run` that verifies binding persistence before cutover. If dry-run fails, abort.

zara: Good. Also we need a documented rollback for operator upgrades that re-applies previous mapping quickly.

ops-bot: Ticket tracker: Created PROD-4999 "alpha: pinned-egress minimal scope" assigned to @felix.

renee: QA matrix notes: - cold restart, - staged upgrade, - node replacement, - simulated IP reclaim. All must be covered for pilot signoff.

felix: Estimate: engineering 3 weeks (1 eng + 0.5 infra + 0.5 QA). Docs + Field enablement another week.

zara: Launch window: opt-in alpha for up to 6 customers, 2-week beta, then expand. Maintenance window suggestion: 01:00-04:00 UTC for upgrades.

field-sam: I'll confirm pilot list (3 customers) and share contact+testing schedule.

renee: We should not advertise preserved IP as GA until KV checksum + BGP support are in. Mark alpha docs prominently: "alpha feature, not GA".

felix: Implementation note: CLI flag example for alpha:

```
installer --profile pinned-egress \
  --egress-ip 203.0.113.45 \
  --preserve-egress true
```

zara: Add a short troubleshooting guide: steps to rebind, how to read reconciliation counter, and how to open support ticket with logs.

ops-bot: CI: nightly alpha build available at http://ci.local/builds/1788880055

field-sam: OK. I'll queue pilots and set expectations with them. Will sync back with results end of week.

zara: Thanks team. Action items: felix -> start spike & PR by Tue; renee -> draft telemetry + QA matrix; field-sam -> pilot confirmations; I'll update PRD addendum.
